prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one transparent bitmap miniature for the browser auto-battler Red Tides.
Primary request: recreate the visual identity of the THIRD aircraft from the left, labeled 幽灵机, in reference image 1, as a single readable full-body game piece.
Input images: image 1 (the original 2019 air roster) is the identity and silhouette reference; image 2 (the existing ghostjet asset) is ONLY a rendering-quality reference, not its crescent-wing design.
Subject: a compact hovering olive-gold mechanical shark-like aircraft. Bulbous rounded armored nose with a dark circular eye sensor, short toothed lower jaw shaped metal intake, a tall swept triangular dorsal fin, stubby swept side fins, compact aft thruster. The body is chunky and aerodynamic, matching the third roster unit, with worn brass / muted olive armor and a pale warm face plate.
Style/medium: polished detailed 3D fantasy science-fiction strategy-game miniature with realistic metal materials, restrained panel wear and cool cyan engine light, matching the existing game's miniature rendering.
Composition/framing: isolated single craft, three-quarter front view facing down-left, elevated isometric camera; center the complete nose, jaw, dorsal fin, side fins and tail in frame with clear transparent padding on every edge. Strong silhouette legible at 100 pixels.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background, no environment or floor, no ground shadow, no colored backdrop.
Constraints: one aircraft only; no pilot or other character; no text, labels, UI, logos or watermark. Keep the olive-gold compact shark silhouette, circular eye and toothed chin intake. Do not copy the neighboring repair drone, bomber or ark.
Avoid: large crescent wings, jade ornaments, ornamental curls, humanoid limbs, landing gear, long gun barrels, giant magical aura, stealth transparency on the body, motion trails. The normal solid-body sprite will receive invisibility and attack effects in code.
referenceRoles: S20第三个幽灵机的身份与轮廓
旧图仅参考渲染品质，不沿用月牙翼与玉饰
processing: 直接复制原生PNG、未编辑像素，旧图保留。
review: 已目视原生输出及实际图鉴／战场。非原客户端模型；alpha边界在左侧触及画布，未宣称四边完全留白。
